summary: - **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#565](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/565)** — get_V0s_jet and get_SV_jets build each jet's V0s and secondary vertices from that jet's own tracks, which changes per-jet vertexing outputs for all analyses using them.

- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#569](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/569)** — get_PrimaryTracks keeps all tracks compatible with the primary vertex, and beam-spot-constrained VertexFitter_Tk fits use 2N degrees of freedom, which rescales the vertex chi2 values in affected analyses.

- **[key4hep/k4geo#683](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/683)** — Magnetic field set to zero outside the muon systems of ALLEGRO, IDEA, CLD_o2_v09 and CLD_o5_v01, which stops escaping particles from curling back into the simulated detector.

- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#128](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/128)** — GGTFTrackFinder identifies input hit collections by their position in the input list instead of unassigned CollectionIDs, fixing crashes and wrong hit-to-track assignments in ALLEGRO and IDEA reconstruction.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#172](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/172)** — k4SimDelphesAlg converts EDM4hep MCParticle production times from ns to mm/c before passing them to Delphes, correcting particle, track and calorimeter timing in Gaudi-based runs.

- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#171](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/171)** — k4SimDelphesAlg fills the RecoMCLink collection, linking reconstructed particles to the input GenParticles, so reco-MC truth matching works in the Gaudi-based Delphes workflow.

- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#447](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/447)** — OverlayTiming adds background contribution energies when merging SimCalorimeterHits and keeps a whole hit if any contribution falls in the time window, which changes overlaid calorimeter energies.

- **[AIDASoft/podio#1082](https://github.com/AIDASoft/podio/pull/1082)** — RNTupleReader reads only the requested collections and caches per-file views, making RNTuple reading about five times faster and skipping collections whose fields cannot be bound.

- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep#1717](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1717)** — Geant4InputHandling uses the start vertex of the first accepted primary particle as the event origin, fixing HepMC3 particle-gun inputs and reverting unreleased changes that broke other inputs.

- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#152](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/152)** — CKF extrapolation to the IP includes material effects such as beam-pipe multiple scattering, correcting underestimated d0/z0 uncertainties of low-momentum tracks in CLD reconstruction.
